regular_mobs.name: Albino
regular_mobs.special: Higher HP than normal Rat. Causes Bleeding on hit

regular_mobs.name: Crab
regular_mobs.special: 2x movement speed. High armor for its level

regular_mobs.name: Swarm
regular_mobs.special: Splits into 2 smaller swarms when hit (each with half HP). High total HP

regular_mobs.name: Skeleton
regular_mobs.special: Explodes on death dealing damageRoll to adjacent chars (with half DR)

regular_mobs.name: Thief
regular_mobs.special: 0.5x attack delay (attacks twice as fast). Steals random item on hit, then flees. Drops Gold when hit while fleeing

regular_mobs.name: Bandit
regular_mobs.special: Steals and also applies Blindness on hit

regular_mobs.name: Shaman
regular_mobs.special: Ranged lightning zap (2-12 dmg, 1.5x in water, TIME_TO_ZAP=2f). Resists Electricity

regular_mobs.name: Bat
regular_mobs.special: 2x movement speed. Vampiric: heals min(damage, HT-HP) on hit. Flying. Resists Leech

regular_mobs.name: Brute
regular_mobs.special: Enrages at low HP, dealing much more damage

regular_mobs.name: Shielded
regular_mobs.special: Higher defense skill and DR than normal Brute

regular_mobs.name: Spinner
regular_mobs.special: Applies Poison on hit. Can web tiles to root hero

regular_mobs.name: Elemental
regular_mobs.special: Immune to fire/Burning. Frost deals massive damage (1 to 2/3 HT). Ranged attack

regular_mobs.name: Warlock
regular_mobs.special: Ranged shadow bolt (12-18 dmg). 50% Weakness on ranged hit. Resists Death

regular_mobs.name: Monk
regular_mobs.special: 0.5x attack delay. Very high evasion and accuracy, low DR. 1/6 chance to disarm hero. Immune to Amok and Terror

regular_mobs.name: Senior
regular_mobs.special: Higher damage than normal Monk. Grants 2x speed buff on hit

regular_mobs.name: Golem
regular_mobs.special: 1.5x attack delay (slow attacker). Very high HP, damage, and DR. Immune to Amok, Terror, Sleep. Resists PsionicBlast

regular_mobs.name: Succubus
regular_mobs.special: Teleports randomly. Charms hero on hit. Heals from charm damage. Flying

regular_mobs.name: Eye
regular_mobs.special: 1.6x attack delay. Death gaze: ranged beam hitting ALL chars in line. Flying. Resists WandOfDisintegration, Death, Leech. Immune to Terror

regular_mobs.name: Scorpio
regular_mobs.special: Ranged attack. Applies Cripple on hit. Retreats when hero is adjacent

regular_mobs.name: Acidic
regular_mobs.special: When damaged by hero, applies Ooze to attacker (1 damage/turn until standing on water)

special_mobs.name: FetidRat
special_mobs.special: Sad Ghost quest target. Emits stench (ToxicGas)

special_mobs.name: Wraith
special_mobs.special: Spawns from disturbed graves/tombstones. Passes through walls. Extremely high evasion, but 1 HP

special_mobs.name: Piranha
special_mobs.special: Water-only mob. Cannot leave water tiles. Scales with dungeon depth. Killing tracked in Statistics.piranhasKilled

special_mobs.name: Mimic
special_mobs.special: Disguises as treasure chest. Level based on floor. Drops items it was guarding

special_mobs.name: Statue
special_mobs.special: Guards an enchanted weapon. Uses the weapon's damage range. Drops the weapon on death

special_mobs.name: CursePersonification
special_mobs.special: Spawned by curse removal. Passes through walls

bosses.name: Goo
bosses.mechanics: 33% chance to pump up (2f delay). Pumped attack has range 2. Heals 1 HP/turn in water. 33% Ooze on hit

bosses.name: Tengu
bosses.mechanics: Teleports when hit. Throws poison darts and places traps. Arena has maze sections

bosses.name: DM-300
bosses.mechanics: Releases ToxicGas. Destroys grass/doors when moving. Very tanky

bosses.name: Dwarf King
bosses.mechanics: Summons Undead minions. Gains armor from undead sacrifices

bosses.name: Yog-Dzewa
bosses.mechanics: Stationary. Spawns RottingFist and BurningFist. Spawns Larvae. Cannot be directly killed until Fists are defeated

RottingFist.special: Heals significantly each turn. Applies Ooze on hit

BurningFist.special: Ranged fire attack. Seeds Fire blobs. Immune to fire

npcs.name: Ghost
npcs.quest: Kill FetidRat. Reward: choice of weapon or armor

npcs.name: Wandmaker
npcs.quest: Collect CorpseDust or seeds. Reward: choice of 2 wands

npcs.name: Blacksmith
npcs.quest: Mine DarkGold ore. Reward: reforge/upgrade weapon

npcs.name: Imp
npcs.quest: Kill monks/golems or collect DwarfTokens. Reward: shop access

npcs.name: Shopkeeper
npcs.description: Sells items. Teleports away if attacked
